item.title: 2026 Stack Overflow Developer Survey results
item.description: More than 30K technologists from 169 countries have shared their thoughts with us, and now it’s time to share everything we’ve learned with you. So let’s dive into this year’s Annual Developer Survey. (3 sources: frontendfocus, javascriptweekly, nodeweekly)

item.title: H3 v2: The UnJS HTTP Framework is Rebuilt on Web Standards
item.description: 🎉 H3 v2 is now stable! It is a full rewrite on top of web standards, stays compatible with most v1 utilities, and is faster and smaller than v1. (2 sources: javascriptweekly, nodeweekly)

item.title: Node.js 26.11.0 (Current) Released
item.description: Node.js® is a free, open-source, cross-platform JavaScript runtime environment that lets developers create servers, web apps, command line tools and scripts. (2 sources: javascriptweekly, nodeweekly)
